Ideas like $$自由$$, $$正義$$, $$人権$$, $$平等$$, $$友情$$, and $$愛$$...
are all considered hypocritical, decadent ideas that don't even exist in $$この世$$...
Among us black $$羽$$, even saying them is frowned upon.
And $$弱者$$ like me...
under $$弱肉強食$$ in $$この世$$, even existing is a $$罪$$...
are all respected as the most natural, animal-like behaviors...
Under $$弱肉強食$$ in $$この世$$, everyone says they're only natural...
$$ゴルゴダ$$ Prison has three underground levels...
The first basement holds criminals guilty of lesser $$罪$$, people scheduled to be simply killed...
The second basement has torture rooms that keep inflicting pain for a person's $$罪$$...
And the third basement, where we are now, was chosen as a $$生けにえ$$ to seal away the $$大邪神$$...
I've heard it's a prison for $$大罪人$$s, kept alive and made to suffer forever...
But I don't really know where they take people with $$罪$$ from here...
Still, at least the $$ご主人様$$ you told me about...
I don't think is here...
Most people with black $$羽$$ live by hunting, so lots of them are nomads, but...
the powerful run estates using $$奴隷$$ and build fortresses to protect their land...
They also gather $$傭兵$$s to show off their power...
But $$傭兵$$s with black $$羽$$ hone their skills every day to overthrow their employers...
So it isn't rare for a $$領主$$ to change without anyone noticing...
In that sense, murder is really an everyday thing...
But $$奴隷$$ with white $$羽$$ like you are strictly forbidden from killing your $$ご主人様$$ or people with black $$羽$$...
It's strictly forbidden!!
But I think for $$レブ$$ and $$ガイさん$$, when the $$異端審問官$$ caught them...
the bigger problem was that they said words like $$自由$$ and $$正義$$...
We black $$羽$$...
are said to be direct descendants of Lord $$メフィスト$$ and $$リリス$$, who won the $$創世記戦争$$...
But over the long years, they say most of those mysterious powers were lost...
Unlike us, though, the few people called $$大神官$$s, with horns growing from their heads...
are said to have inherited the miraculous power called $$黒魔術$$...
Rumor has it that among them,
One day, the $$大邪神$$ who seeks to reclaim the $$世界$$ will return, and a god will return to stop him!
is a legend they truly believe in...
They say Lady $$プラハ$$, the $$獄長$$ here, is a very wicked person...
But since she came, torture and executions have gone way down...
She's never even hit me,
and the other guards complain behind her back that she's neglecting her duties!
Lord $$カロン$$, the $$獄長$$ here, is very popular with the other guards.
He's first-rate in every one of the $$七つの美徳$$: $$憤怒$$, $$嫉妬$$, $$怠惰$$, pride, $$暴食$$, $$強欲$$, and $$欲情$$!
They say he's an exemplary person!
Since he came, torture and executions have skyrocketed!
I'm sorry...
But I have no idea where they took your $$ご主人様$$...
I really can't imagine it...
